summary: Ubuntu 23.10 (Mantic Minotaur) was released on 12 October 2023. Features: GNOME 45, kernel 6.5, installer improvements. The minotaur is a mythical creature; 'mantic' relates to prophecy and wisdom. Preparatory release for 24.04 LTS.
notes: Unsupported since 2024-07-11. Kernel 6.5. Last interim before Noble Numbat LTS.
